clause_text: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Vendor's total aggregate liability arising out of or related to the Cloud Service shall not exceed $50,000 or the subscription fees paid in the last 6 months.
Vendor agrees to defend Customer against any third-party legal claims alleging that Customer's authorized use of the software infringes any valid patent or copyright.
Licensee shall not reverse engineer, decompile, or develop a substantially similar competing cloud service utilizing Vendor's benchmark metrics.
The subscription term shall automatically renew for additional consecutive periods equal to twelve (12) months unless either party provides notice of non-renewal at least 30 days prior to expiration.
Customer may terminate the subscription for convenience upon forty-five (45) days prior written notice, subject to forfeiture of prepaid fees.
Neither Supplier nor Purchaser shall be liable for indirect or punitive damages; Supplier liability for defective hardware is strictly capped at product replacement costs.
Purchaser reserves the right to terminate any Purchase Order without penalty upon twenty-one (21) days notice to Supplier.
Supplier warrants product compliance and agrees to defend Purchaser from IP infringement actions brought by third parties.
All unit pricing models, discount schedules, and specifications are confidential trade secrets.
The procurement term shall continue for twenty-four (24) months and renew annually upon mutual written consent.
